scene: Pocketing the wet key, you find three distinct transit gates ready outside.
picture: A wide flat terrace view with the elderly man in blue cap and orange cardigan holding his cane in the centre. Far left stands a red monorail with open doors. Left is a tea cart. Right waits a tilted wooden funicular car. Far right sits a clockwork rickshaw with glowing headlights.
shown: a sleek red monorail carriage idling at an elevated gantry far left
a wooden funicular car waiting on steep sloped tracks to the right
a mechanical brass rickshaw with a smiling robot driver on the far right

variants.scene: Key tucked away, you view three grand rides above the purple dusk skyline.
Steam curls from the tea cart as three different routes await your choice.
Humming {tune}, you steady your cane before the bustling transit platform.
